data.name: Abida
data.gender_notes: Abida is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Feminine of ʿābid, from the Arabic root ع-ب-د (ʿ-b-d), 'to worship'. Its root is ع-ب-د (ʿ-b-d). A common Muslim female name. Abida is a Arabic name meaning “Worshipper (female); devout”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abida expresses “Worshipper (female); devout”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Feminine of ʿābid, from the Arabic root ع-ب-د (ʿ-b-d), 'to worship'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abida total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
